full_prompt_en: A square atmospheric architectural drawing shows immense elevated arches crossing a dark industrial waterway. The view looks into a narrow city canyon from water level, with tall shadowed structures rising on both sides and receding into pale mist. An enormous bridge spans the upper frame from left to right. Its broad masonry arches create a sequence of high open voids, each opening a little smaller and fainter toward the center distance. Vertical supports descend almost to the water and divide the glowing gaps into a rhythm of heavy blue-gray masses and warm ivory light. Behind the main span, another bridge crosses the central opening farther back, visible as a thinner horizontal line. On the left bank, dense silhouettes of towers, smokestacks, and blocky factory roofs cluster in deep navy shadow. A plume of white smoke rises from a low vessel or industrial outlet near the waterline. A dark barge sits across the lower left, with a thin upright stack and a few small points of light along its edge. On the right, heavy shadowed buildings compress the channel. The water at the bottom is nearly still and dark, carrying only dim broken reflections from the pale distant opening and the bank lights. The scene is rendered in layered charcoal-like blue washes and granular pencil texture, with architectural edges softened by smoke and distance. Backlight glows warm cream through the arches, while the foreground masses stay cool and nearly black. There is no obvious direct sun or crisp cast shadow; light is filtered through the entire hazy canyon. The high bridge dominates the scale, and the low, small vessel gives measure to the immense vertical space. Repeated arches and fading silhouettes make the composition solemn, monumental, and deep.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形的大气建筑绘画呈现巨大的高架拱桥横跨深暗工业水道。视点从水面高度望入狭窄城市峡谷，两侧高耸的阴影建筑朝浅雾深处退去。一座巨桥从左到右跨过画面上方。宽阔的石质拱洞构成一列高大的开放空隙，越向中央远处越小、越淡。竖向支撑几乎落到水面，将发亮空隙分割成沉重蓝灰块面与暖象牙白光的节奏。主桥后面，还有另一道桥从中央开口更远处穿过，只见较细横线。左岸由塔楼、烟囱和方块厂房屋顶的密集剪影组成，沉在深海军蓝阴影里。一股白烟从水线旁的低矮船只或工业出口升起。左下有一艘暗驳船，带着细竖烟囱，边缘还有几处微小亮点。右侧沉重的阴影建筑把水道压紧。底部水面近乎静止且深暗，只留下远处浅色开口和岸边灯光的断续微弱倒影。画面以层层叠加的炭笔般蓝色水洗和颗粒铅笔质地描绘，建筑边缘被烟与距离软化。逆光从拱洞间发出暖奶油色亮度，前景大块体则冷而近黑。看不见明确的太阳或清晰投影；光经过整条雾气峡谷过滤。高桥控制了尺度，低矮小船则量出巨大的竖向空间。重复拱形与逐渐消失的剪影让构图肃穆、宏伟而深远。
style_prompt_en: Atmospheric drawing layers granular blue-gray washes over a fine charcoal-like texture. Immense vertical masses and repeated curved openings establish scale, while pale negative spaces step backward through successive layers of haze. Cool navy and slate dominate the near frame, and warm cream is reserved for distant luminous gaps. Heavy foreground silhouettes carry hard lower edges but lose their upper contours in smoke-like softness. Fine linear structure survives only near the central passage; farther forms dissolve into broad tonal blocks. Backlight filters through the depth rather than striking surfaces sharply, so reflections remain faint and broken. The composition is low in viewpoint and high in vertical reach, balancing dense dark sides against a narrow glowing route into the distance.
style_prompt_zh: 大气绘画把有颗粒的蓝灰水洗层层叠在细密炭笔般肌理上。巨大的竖向色块与重复曲线开口建立尺度，浅色负空间穿过一层层雾向后递退。冷海军蓝与石板灰主导近处画面，暖奶油色只留给远方发亮空隙。沉重前景剪影下缘较硬，上方轮廓却在烟般柔度中消失。细线结构只在中央通道附近存留，更远形体溶成宽阔明暗块。逆光穿过纵深过滤，而非锐利击中表面，因此倒影微弱且断续。构图视点低、竖向延伸高，以两侧浓密暗色平衡一道通往远方的狭窄辉光。
theme_en: Immense elevated arches over a smoky industrial waterway
theme_zh: 巨大的高架拱桥跨过烟雾弥漫的工业水道
name: Hugh Ferriss
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
